name: Plausible Analytics
summary: Plausible is a simple, privacy-first website analytics tool that counts visitors and page views without using cookies.

free_plan_covers.note: Plausible has no permanent free plan, only a 30-day free trial with no credit card required.

first_paid_usd_month.note: The Starter plan costs $9 a month billed monthly and covers up to 10,000 monthly pageviews.

portability.note: Plausible's self-hosted Community Edition is open source under AGPLv3, and both cloud and self-hosted data can be exported as CSV or through the Stats API.

cookies.note: Plausible never sets cookies or stores persistent identifiers, so it needs no cookie consent banner.

product_events.note: Custom events can track button clicks, signups or any other action, either by adding a CSS class or calling the plausible() function.

setup.step: Sign up for Plausible and add your site to start the 30-day free trial.
Install next-plausible with npm install next-plausible.
Wrap your app in PlausibleProvider, pointing it at the script src shown on your site's Plausible dashboard.
Use the usePlausible hook to send custom events beyond the automatic page view tracking.

builder_notes: Plausible never sets cookies, so do not add a cookie consent banner just for this tool.
Custom events count toward the monthly billable pageview quota, so only track actions that matter, not every render.
